description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Added lwjgl3ify compatibility — GT New Horizons (MC 1.7.10 + lwjgl3ify/RFB, Java 17+) now works out of the box; Legacy Fabric / Legacy Fabric API loader installation was synced from upstream HMCL.
2. World save capabilities synced from upstream HMCL: world list entries now show world icons with a copy-world action, and the new 26.1 save format is supported (external world_gen_settings / player data / difficulty settings, etc.).
3. A new shader pack management tab was added to the manage page, supporting import, rename, search, multi-select deletion and more (enabling/disabling is left to in-game shader mods such as Iris/OptiFine).
4. Version icon recognition synced from upstream: snapshots and pre-release versions now show a command block icon.
5. Theme color transparency is now shown as a percentage, and the menu selection color is no longer affected by theme transparency.
6. Fixed AWT falling back to headless on jre25 (cacio17 updated to a JDK 25 fixed build), duplicated input with external physical keyboards, and a crash when pressing enter in the controller repository search box on custom ROMs.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.新增 lwjgl3ify 兼容，开箱即玩 GT New Horizons（MC 1.7.10 + lwjgl3ify/RFB，Java 17+）；同步上游 HMCL 的 Legacy Fabric / Legacy Fabric API 加载器安装
2.世界存档能力同步上游 HMCL：世界列表新增世界图标与复制世界入口，支持 26.1 新存档格式（世界生成设置与玩家数据外置、难度设置等）
3.管理页新增光影管理 tab，支持光影包导入、重命名、搜索、多选删除等（启用/禁用由游戏内光影模组完成）
4.版本图标识别同步上游：快照与预发布版显示命令方块图标
5.主题色透明度改为百分比显示，菜单选中色不受主题透明度影响
6.修复 jre25 下 AWT 回退 headless（cacio17 更新至 jdk25 修复版构建）、外接物理键盘输入重复、定制 ROM 上控制器仓库搜索框回车崩溃等问题
